Tips: bytt rad {r1}, kolonne {k1} med ra: Hint: swap row {r1}, column {k1} with row {r2}, column {k2}.
Ekornet samler til vinteren. Bytt plass: The squirrel is stocking up for winter. Swap two pieces that sit side by side to line up three or more alike.
Sveip en brikke mot naboen, eller trykk: Swipe a piece towards its neighbour, or tap one and then the other. A swap only counts when it makes a line.
Tre eller flere like på rad forsvinner,: Three or more alike in a line disappear, and what's above falls down. When new lines form by themselves, each one is worth more.
På hvert brett står det hva du skal saml: Every level shows what to collect and how many moves you have. If you run out of moves, just have another go.
Fire på rad gir en pilbrikke. Når den ry: Four in a line leaves an arrow piece. When it's cleared, it takes the whole row or column with it – the arrows show which way.
Fem på rad, eller en L eller en T, gir e: Five in a line, or an L or a T, leaves a star piece that clears everything around it.
Lag rader langt nede på brettet: Da fall: Make lines low down on the board: more falls, and you'll get several lines at once more often.
Hver ting har sin egen form, så du treng: Every piece has its own shape, so you don't need to tell the colours apart.
Står du fast, viser ekornet et tips ette: Stuck? After a little while the squirrel shows you a hint. If there are no moves at all, the board shuffles itself.
Med tastatur: Piltastene flytter, Enter: With a keyboard: the arrow keys move, Enter or Space selects, and an arrow key swaps with the neighbour. H gives a hint and P pauses.
30 trekk: Så mange poeng du klarer på tr: 30 moves: as many points as you can in thirty moves – and a high score to beat.
Swap, match and stock up for winter.
Tre like på rad – og det regner nøtter!: Three alike in a line – and it rains acorns!
Spill et brett på nytt og jakt på tre st: Play a level again and go for three stars.
Brettet, 8 ganger 8. Flytt med piltasten: The board, 8 by 8. Move with the arrow keys, select with Enter, swap with an arrow key.
Sveip en brikke mot naboen: Swipe a piece towards its neighbour
Piltaster flytter · Enter velger · H gir: Arrows move · Enter selects · H for a hint
Godt jobba! Spill igjen for flere stjern: Well done! Play again for more stars.
Det manglet bare {liste}. Prøv igjen – d: Only {liste} to go. Have another go – you get as many tries as you like.
Første runde – nå har du en rekord å slå: First round – now you have a score to beat!
